hypotheses.justification: It follows from [Φ.FiniteIndex] and hΦΓ by Subgroup.finiteIndex_of_le. Delete the binder and start the proof with `haveI : Γ'.FiniteIndex := Subgroup.finiteIndex_of_le hΦΓ`; the remaining proof is unchanged. This implication has no nontriviality assumptions.

This follows from [IsFreeGroup Φ]. Choose a free group basis using IsFreeGroup.nonempty_basis. Its repr embeds Φ into a FreeGroup, whose torsion-freeness is established in Mathlib/GroupTheory/FreeGroup/CyclicallyReduced.lean. If -1 belonged to Φ, its square would be 1, so pow_eq_one_iff_left applied to its image would force it to equal 1. Comparing the (0,0) integer matrix entries gives -1 = 1, a contradiction. Derive hΦ1 locally and retain the original proof. This argument also covers trivial Φ and is independent of R.
